key_insight: DFT screening shows K/Rb-based SnGeX6 double perovskites are stable, ductile, and highly tunable lead-free semiconductors with bandgaps and thermoelectric performance controlled by halogen choice.
engineering_relevance: These compounds offer a scalable materials platform for safer perovskite photovoltaics, tandem/IR optoelectronics, and high-temperature waste-heat recovery devices.
method: Density functional theory (DFT) structural and electronic-property calculations
Elastic-constant analysis for mechanical stability and ductility
Thermoelectric transport assessment using band-structure-derived transport indicators
evidence_signal: The abstract reports six thermodynamically stable cubic compounds with direct bandgaps tunable from 1.44 to 0.64 eV and a peak ZT of 2.4 for K2SnGeI6 at 1000 K.
watch_item: The results are computational and high-temperature performance may shift when defects, synthesis limits, and real-device microstructure are included.
paper_title: First-Principles Study of Novel Lead-Free Double Perovskite \b{eta}2SnGeX6 (\b{eta} = K, Rb; X = Cl, Br, I) for thermomechanical, optoelectronic and outstanding thermoelectric applications
